svg.aria-label: 403: A CRS rule blocked the request. The WAF logs the rule IDs and the path, never the query or body. 413 and 429: Body over 1 MiB, or more than 50 requests per second from one IP (burst 100). 500: The WAF did not answer. The edge fails closed and lets nothing through
